They are now dressed in yukatas; the shorter woman is in a dark purple floral yukata, while the taller woman wears a white one with blue floral patterns and a purple sash. The shorter woman smiles at the camera, and the taller woman again raises her arm high. The outdoor platform is brightly lit by natural daylight. (5) The final scene takes place at the entrance of a building with a complex, mirrored geometric ceiling design. The women are in different casual outfits; the shorter woman wears a white shirt and plaid skirt, while the taller woman wears a beige halter top and grey trousers. Many pedestrians are visible in the background on escalators.
